blocks.text: [Updated Nov. 4, 2026, 8:57 p.m.] MANILA, Philippines — Some schools suspended in-person classes on Thursday, Nov. 5, due to the expected extreme heat conditions. Below are the following educational institutions that suspended classes: READ: Western Visayas schools suspend classes due to 43°C heat index Iloilo City, Iloilo Roxas City, Capiz The suspension is in line with the Department of Education’s Memorandum No. 64, Series of 2026, which allows public schools to suspend classes and academic activities once the heat index reaches danger category (42°C and above).
